subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: What should OpenClaw's source-channel delivery boundary be for assistant text emitted before or between tool calls?
rationale: The source confirms a live leak class, but the durable fix changes user-visible reply defaults and security expectations for existing channel setups, so automation should not choose the permanent policy alone.

options.title: Private by default for channel text
options.body: Suppress internal, commentary, and inter-tool assistant text on channel surfaces unless it is a final deliverable response or an explicit `message(action=send)` payload, with clear agent feedback for private text.

options.title: Keep automatic defaults with classifiers
options.body: Preserve current automatic reply behavior and add targeted provider/phase/tool-boundary classifiers, accepting a larger ongoing audit surface for every delivery path.

options.title: Offer opt-in final-tag enforcement only
options.body: Add a configuration-only mitigation such as final-tag enforcement while leaving the default automatic leak class available for users who do not opt in.

recommendation.title: Private by default for channel text
recommendation.body: Suppress internal, commentary, and inter-tool assistant text on channel surfaces unless it is a final deliverable response or an explicit `message(action=send)` payload, with clear agent feedback for private text.
